trigger.observed_line: The retained interop failure in `M3SpringArrayContractTest.realSpringSixTwoDifferentialSeeded` is a test-oracle defect. The test aborts when the M3 side throws a legitimate `UnsupportedOperationException` before executing the corresponding Spring operation. The current production owner preserves the existing Spring contract: lists supplied through `put`/`putAll` keep their reference and mutability; `asSingleValueMap().put` can install an immutable singleton list. Attempting to append to one of those lists can therefore fail on both sides.
